messages:
sophie_csm: Heads-up — we have a set of onboarding tenants (approx 18) who saw partial index writes and delayed activations during the 03/21 weekend window. I'm flagging renewal-risk for 3 high-touch customers. Need a short status + RCA + mitigation note we can send, plus an invite for office hours later today.

maria_cs: Ack. Can we confirm whether any of the affected tenants had Dedicated pools? That changes the crediting ask. :thinking_face: 

aj_sre: ops_bot created incident INC-2026-03121 at 1755011200 — root cause investigation in progress. Quick telemetry: spike in request retries + queue depth on our ingestion workers between 02:10–02:42 UTC.

raj_infra: Early summary: a batching retry loop was triggered by a rare timeout + duplicate ack from the indexing service. Retries amplified a burst that exhausted the worker concurrency budget for some customers on shared onboarding pipelines. Not related to Dedicated pools specifically — affected both shared and a couple of isolated tenants.

ops_bot: [incident created] INC-2026-03121 | severity=sev2 | owner=@aj_sre | tags=[onboarding, ingest, retry-loop]

sophie_csm: Draft customer-facing blurb (short). Please review/edit: ```We experienced a partial onboarding delay for some accounts between 02:10–02:42 UTC on 2026-03-21. Root cause: an internal retry amplification during indexing which slowed writes for a subset of tenants. Mitigation: we’ve patched the retry logic and reprocessed affected writes; most customers are back to normal. We’ll host an office hours at 17:00 UTC today to walk through impact and next steps. We’re offering a targeted one-week account credit for high-touch customers — we’ll follow up individually.```

maria_cs: LGTM. Suggest adding exact next steps: timeline for reindex complete, how to validate their data, and contact for escalation. Also propose the credit wording: "one week of service credit to offset onboarding delay".

aj_sre: Confirming patch rolled at 1755012400 UTC — rate limiter and a guard against duplicate ack retries pushed. Reprocess jobs started at 1755012500 and currently ~85% complete for affected tenants. Error rates are down to baseline.

raj_infra: Evidence: queue depth metric (ingest_worker_pending) peaked at 132 -> baseline 18. After the patch, pending ~14. We're still watching tail latencies for longer index operations but no further retries observed.

sophie_csm: Updated customer message with Maria's additions. Final draft below — please thumbs if we can send: 

```Hello — we want to let you know about a partial onboarding delay affecting some accounts between 02:10–02:42 UTC on 2026-03-21. What happened: an internal retry amplification during indexing caused slower writes for a subset of tenants. What we did: we deployed a fix to prevent the retry loop, reprocessed affected writes, and continuously monitored system health. Current status: reprocessing is ~85% complete and most accounts are back to normal; we expect full completion within 4 hours. Next steps: we’ll host office hours at 17:00 UTC today to review impact and answer questions (link). If you’d like targeted assistance, reply to this message and we’ll schedule a dedicated session. Compensation: we’re offering a one-week service credit for high-touch customers who were impacted — we will reach out directly to eligible accounts. Apologies for the disruption — we’re improving our retry detection to avoid recurrence. — The Redwood Inference Team```

maria_cs: :thumbsup: send when ready. Also include a small checklist for customers to validate: (1) verify index counts, (2) run sample queries, (3) let us know if missing docs. I can personalize outreach for the 3 renewal-risk accounts.

aj_sre: Sending OK from SRE side. Adding monitoring alert rules to detect similar amplification patterns (new alert at 1755012600).

raj_infra: Postmortem note for CS to reference in follow-ups: root cause = duplicate ack path + unbounded retry backoff in the ingestion worker; fix = bounded retry + idempotency check + backpressure. ETA for full postmortem doc: EOD 2026-03-21.

ops_bot: [update] INC-2026-03121 mitigation=deployed | reprocess_progress=85% | status=monitoring

sophie_csm: Thanks team. Maria — please send the final draft to affected tenants, CC me. I'll own eligibility and credits. Aj/Raj — please DM if any reprocess jobs slip beyond 6 hours. We’ll capture feedback during office hours and include any customer asks in the postmortem.

maria_cs: On it — message going out now to the affected list, office hours link included. I’ll post a short thread with the list of accounts we reached out to (internal only).

aj_sre: Noted. Will push final alert and keep watch.

raj_infra: Will attach a short log snippet in the postmortem showing the duplicate ack pattern.

sophie_csm: Closing loop here — thanks all.
